title: Convenings
intro: Closed-door dinners and roundtables for people at banks, asset managers, market infrastructure institutions and regulators, with the researchers and builders working on Ethereum.
empty: Further convenings are listed here once they are confirmed.

items.label: Private dinner · 25 seats
items.title: ETHIndia Institutional Dinner
items.summary: A closed-door dinner for 25 people who are building or backing Ethereum's institutional adoption in India. Seats are by invitation from the hosts.

items.label: Open mixer · 100 guests
items.title: Institutional Open Doors Mixer
items.summary: An evening for 100 people following Ethereum's institutional adoption more broadly: banks and financial institutions, advisory firms and policy groups, Ethereum researchers and builders, and Devcon guests.
